news.title: VentureBeat Research: Where enterprise AI agent governance hasn't caught up
news.summary_raw: Enterprises deployed AI agents ahead of the controls needed to manage them — and they did it knowingly. That is the central finding across the five parallel surveys VentureBeat Research fielded in June, spanning every layer of the agentic stack. news.summary: A VentureBeat Research study reveals that enterprises deployed AI agents before adequate governance controls, leading to a high rate of plan-driven vendor changes. This highlights the need for enterprises to retrospectively implement AI management standards.
news.enterprise_use: Review your current AI agent vendor landscape and plan for potential changes within the next 12 months, considering budget allocation for governance and control improvements. Inaction may result in inefficient vendor management and security risks. JumpCloud and Google Workspace AI integrations can be evaluated for their governance capabilities.
